capabilities: Record voice memos from the end of a note, command palette, ribbon, or mobile toolbar
Transcribe recordings through OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoints
Clean up transcripts with an LLM using note context and custom terminology
Append cleaned text, optional original transcript, and dated headings to the target note
Retry, download, reassign, or delete saved recordings from a job queue
extras: Not yet in the Community Plugins directory; must be installed manually from a GitHub release or built from source. Recordings and transcripts are stored locally in IndexedDB (not synced), and audio from completed jobs is deleted after seven days.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture spoken thoughts as cleaned-up text in a note, especially on mobile.

relations.evidence: Choose the OpenAI, OpenRouter, or Custom preset, then select an existing LLM provider secret
OpenRouter can handle both steps with the plugin's single API key

requires.name: API key for configured transcription/LLM provider
Provider account (OpenAI, OpenRouter, or custom), unless a local endpoint needs none

summary: Voice capture plugin that records a thought, transcribes and LLM-cleans it through configurable OpenAI-compatible providers, and appends the text to the active note.
